title: Ordinary rank-one calculation and unit classes
statement: In the finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], over every algebraically closed extension Ω of the base, and for every N≥1 killing A, the canonical root coefficient map has the specified scalar-extension formula. Ordinary cohomology of the affine line is acyclic in positive degrees, punctured-line cohomology vanishes above degree one, H1 is A on the actual Kummer class of t, and degree-zero restriction is an isomorphism. Every punctured-line unit is c*t^r and its Kummer class is r times that of t.

proof.text: Invertibility of ell in the base and its image in Ω gives hm. Use the actual coefficient quotient finiteness, and apply finite_line_cohomology. The coefficient morphism is ordinaryFiniteRootMap, whose sectionwise formula is definitional.

Identify polynomial sections using AffineSpace.SpecIso and localization at the coordinate using Gamma of a basic open. Compare the localization ring equivalence with Laurent evaluation at the actual coordinate unit. Transport the Laurent-unit description along it.

Kummer classes are additive because Ext composition and the evaluation comparisons are additive. An m-th power has zero class: its represented morphism factors through the power map, whose composite with the Kummer extension vanishes. Take an m-th root of c in Ω and use the integer-power law to obtain kappa(c*t^r)=r*kappa(t).

theorem rankOne_etale_calculation (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ N : ℕ) : P.Coefficient) = 0)
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra P.field.k Ω] :
    let S := Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)
    let X := Line S
    let F := Scheme.finiteEtaleTateSheaf P.Coefficient (P.coefficients.l ^ N) X hA 1
    let H := ((sections X.smallEtaleTopology P.Coefficient (openObject S)).rightDerived 1).obj F
    ∃ (hm : IsUnit ((P.coefficients.l ^ N : ℕ) : Γ(X, ⊤)))
      (f : X.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ N) ⟶
        (Etale.moduleAbelianForget P.Coefficient X).obj F),
      (∀ (V : X.Etaleᵒᵖ) (z : (X.rootsOfUnitySheaf (P.coefficients.l ^ N)).obj.obj V),
        f.hom.app V z = Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator P.Coefficient
          (P.coefficients.l ^ N) X hA V 1 z) ∧
      ∃ e : H ≅ ModuleCat.of P.Coefficient P.Coefficient,
        e.hom (kummerClass P.Coefficient X (openObject S) F
          (P.coefficients.l ^ N) hm f (coordinateUnit S)) = 1 ∧
        (∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero (((sections X.smallEtaleTopology P.Coefficient
          (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))).rightDerived q).obj F)) ∧
        (∀ q : ℕ, 2 ≤ q → IsZero (((sections X.smallEtaleTopology P.Coefficient
          (openObject S)).rightDerived q).obj F)) ∧
        IsIso ((NatTrans.rightDerived
          (F := sections X.smallEtaleTopology P.Coefficient (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X)))
          (G := sections X.smallEtaleTopology P.Coefficient (openObject S))
          ((sheafSections X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)).map
            (restriction S).op) 0).app F) ∧
        (∀ v : Γ(Punctured S, ⊤)ˣ, ∃ (c : Ωˣ) (r : ℤ),
          v = constantUnit Ω c * coordinateUnit S ^ r) ∧
        (∀ (c : Ωˣ) (r : ℤ),
          kummerClass P.Coefficient X (openObject S) F (P.coefficients.l ^ N) hm f
            (constantUnit Ω c * coordinateUnit S ^ r) =
          r • kummerClass P.Coefficient X (openObject S) F (P.coefficients.l ^ N) hm f
            (coordinateUnit S))
